title: Island map layout
description: ui/world_map/layout.yaml of the game pack: the areas of the island map the M key opens and the roads between them (docs/modulos/apps/game.md). Each area lists the map names (main.map_names slots) whose maps lie in it.

canvas.description: The canvas the areas are placed on: [width, height], y down.

name.description: The main.map_names slot of the area's name.

places.description: The main.map_names slots (a map's loading name) of the maps in the area.

at.description: The area's centre on the canvas.

roads.description: Roads drawn between two areas, by id.
